exploration.admitted_set_statement: INNER_SAMPLE: the admitted points are the evaluated points found admitted by a budgeted deterministic search; they are a subset of the admitted region, not its boundary, and hull_box is a box over these points, not the region.

boundary_cause_legend.COMPUTATIONAL_BOX_EDGE_ADMITTED: the exact box-edge evaluation was admitted: the side is limited by the computational box, not by the data
boundary_cause_legend.COMPUTATIONAL_BOX_EDGE_AT_LAST_ADMITTED: the last admitted point already lies on the box edge
boundary_cause_legend.COMPUTATIONAL_BOX_FACE_NO_EVALUATION: the anchor lies on a box face with an outward direction: no evaluation, limited by the computational box
boundary_cause_legend.DOUBLING_GUARD: the doubling guard stopped the march (S1)
boundary_cause_legend.INVALID_EVALUATION: an invalid evaluation stopped the march (then bisected); not evidence of rejection
boundary_cause_legend.INVALID_EVALUATION_AT_BOX_EDGE: the exact box-edge evaluation was invalid (then bisected)
boundary_cause_legend.REJECTED_EVALUATION: a valid evaluation outside the closed rectangle stopped the march (then bisected)
boundary_cause_legend.REJECTED_EVALUATION_AT_BOX_EDGE: the exact box-edge evaluation was valid and rejected (then bisected)
boundary_cause_legend.UNFINISHED: the side did not finish (budget exhausted)

coverage.statement: INNER_SAMPLE: the admitted points are the evaluated points found admitted by a budgeted deterministic search; they are a subset of the admitted region, not its boundary, and hull_box is a box over these points, not the region.

exploration.u_semantics: u in [0,1] per varying coordinate: dimensionless fraction of the computational trial box in x

identifiability.identification_rule: identified iff (s_i > 0 and s_i >= effective_null_tolerance * s_max) or s_i >= ABSOLUTE_IDENTIFICATION_THRESHOLD (z = 2.865260238532134); effective_null_tolerance = max(null_tolerance, MIN_NULL_TOLERANCE, max(m, n) * eps); singular values are per unit of u, i.e. per computational box (box-dependent)

null_space_completion.basis: full_matrices=True right singular vectors (n x n); padded directions span the exact null space of the m x n scaled Jacobian and are listed in near_null

reasons: NOTE (v003b SF-2): exactly-zero scaled-Jacobian column(s) [1] (['b']): right vector(s) [1] set to +e_j; components up to 0.000e+00 on those columns removed from the other right vectors, renormalised
identifiability.singular_value_units: sigma-scaled speed (dimensionless, per row sigma) per unit of u (fraction of computational box)

spec.u_semantics: u in [0,1] per varying coordinate: dimensionless fraction of the computational trial box in x
